A '''submachinegun''' was a type of [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]], a rapid-fire [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]].

==Description==
The submachineguns were rapid-fire [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] [[Rifle/Legends|rifles]]. Depending on the design, these slugthrower weapons fired multiple bullets of 4&ndash;10 bursts before needing to be reloaded.<ref name="TRG1" />

==Usage==
Submachineguns were used by the military of neo-atomic civilizations.<ref name="TRG1" />

Weapons of this design also hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Pendal]]. It was a rapid-fire projectile-based weapon equivalent to a more modern [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]]. The [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Callandri]], a native of Pendal, was noted for favoring this type of weapon.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
